features: 112-Key Full Layout with Numeric Keypad – Complete Wireless Setup: Full-size 112-key wireless keyboard with a dedicated number pad gives you every key you need for data entry, office work, and everyday computing — completely cable-free with a single shared nano USB receiver.

Stable 2.4GHz Wireless – 10-Metre Range, Zero Dropouts: The nano USB receiver connects both keyboard and mouse simultaneously via a stable 2.4GHz wireless link, providing a reliable, lag-free connection up to 10 metres — ideal for living room setups, large desks, and flexible workspaces.

Adjustable Height Stand & Spill-Resistant Build – Ergonomic & Durable: The retractable height-adjustment feet let you set the typing angle that's most comfortable for your wrists, while the spill-resistant keyboard surface adds protection against everyday accidents.

1000 DPI Optical Mouse with Anti-Slip Scroll Wheel – Smooth Everyday Control: The bundled wireless mouse with a 1000 DPI sensor and anti-slip scroll wheel provides accurate, responsive cursor control for documents, browsing, and multitasking throughout the workday.
Plug & Play Nano Receiver – No Drivers Needed – 1 Year Warranty: One tiny nano receiver connects both devices instantly on Windows 11/10/8/7 and macOS. Backed by EVM's 1-Year manufacturer warranty.
description: Introducing the EVM-WLKM-045 Wireless Keyboard & Mouse Combo, where style meets functionality seamlessly. With 2.4G wireless technology, enjoy a 10-meter working range without the hassle of wires. Simply plug in the USB receiver for instant connectivity – no setup required. Typing feels effortless with 112 keys and smooth keystrokes, while the anti-slip grille roller ensures precise navigation. Embrace nostalgia with the retro typewriter theme and round keys. Backed by a 1-year warranty, this combo guarantees reliability. Elevate your workspace today!
